_note: Fictional demo enquiries used by the portfolio sample. No real company or person.

records.subject: A4 copy paper - quarterly price request
records.body:
Hi, this is Marta Kowalski from Northwind Office Supply (US).

We buy A4 copy paper, 500 sheets per box, roughly 400 boxes a quarter.
Our current supplier charges us $6.80 per box. Could you quote around $6.20 if we commit to a quarterly order?

We need this confirmed before the end of the month as our purchasing cycle closes. Thanks.

Marta Kowalski
m.kowalski@northwind-office.example

records.subject: Heavy duty stapler 65mm - 120 units
records.body:
Hello,

Devi Anand here from Blue Harbor Logistics, based in India. We are looking at heavy duty staplers, 65mm, for our warehouse team. Quantity is 120 units for the first order.

Our budget is around 22 dollars per unit. Delivery to Chennai would be ideal. No rush, we can wait a couple of weeks.

Best,
Devi Anand
devi@blueharbor.example

records.subject: Ergonomic mouse - catalogue request
records.body:
Hi there,

Sam O'Brien from Kestrel Media, United Kingdom. We would like a catalogue and your price list for ergonomic mice. We are thinking about 60 units for the studio team.

We are not in a hurry at all - just exploring options for next quarter. A price guide would be most helpful.

Thanks,
Sam O'Brien
sam@kestrelmedia.example

records.subject: LED desk lamp - 250 units, urgent
records.body:
Hello,

Emma Clark, Pinewood Retail Ltd, United States. We refit 12 stores in January and need 250 LED desk lamps delivered before the refit starts.

Target price is 18 dollars per lamp. This is time sensitive - can you confirm stock and delivery by early January?

Emma Clark
emma.clark@pinewoodretail.example

records.subject: Ballpoint pens - bulk order enquiry
records.body:
Good afternoon,

Yuki Tanaka from Lumen Print Works (Japan). We would like to order 900 packs of ballpoint pens, 10 pens per pack, in black.

Our target is 0.45 per pen. Please send your bulk pricing and lead time. Medium urgency - we need it before our print run in March.

Regards,
Yuki Tanaka
yuki@lumenprint.example
